name: 韩漫风
description: 整洁精细的线条配合柔和赛璐璐上色，色彩明亮协调，具有清爽韩漫画面感。
rendering_prompt: Use the clean, refined drawing language of modern Korean webcomics. Make lines smooth and tidy, contours accurate, and details carefully distilled, with restrained line-weight variation. Base coloring on clear blocks and soft cel shading, adding a few smooth gradients and delicate highlights within a bright, harmonious palette. Gently idealize structure and materials without losing recognizability. Keep the overall two-dimensional treatment light, detailed, and easy to read.
avoid: 自动生成对话框、全画面三维渲染、过度磨皮
difference: 韩漫重清爽数码线稿；复古赛璐璐重手工墨线和胶片感
tuning: 控制线宽变化，减少不必要细节，以明亮统一色盘保持可读性。
